mapper.insert: insert into biz_notice (title, content, author_id, top, create_time) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, 0, now())
insert into biz_remark (notice_id, uid, content, create_time) values (#{noticeId}, #{uid}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: select r.id, r.uid, r.content, r.create_time, a.nickname from biz_remark r left join sys_account a on r.uid = a.id where r.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by r.id desc
